sources.title_en: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
sources.title_original: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
sources.summary: We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics. The post ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 我們推出了 ReviewBench，這是一個專為程式碼審查代理程式打造的基準測試，建構在具有代表性的 GitHub Pull Request、多重來源真實標準（ground truth）、經過校準的評估以及與生產環境一致的指標上。本文 ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review 最初發布於 The GitHub Blog。

stories.title: Reflection 的 Beam 成為中國境外打造的最強大開放權重模型 / Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China

sources.title: Reflection 的 Beam 成為中國境外打造的最強大開放權重模型 / Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.title_zh: Reflection 的 Beam 成為中國境外打造的最強大開放權重模型
sources.title_en: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.title_original: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
sources.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Reflection 發布了其首款開放權重模型 Beam。這套混合專家系統在每個 token 中僅啟動 501 億個參數中的 23 億個，旨在以少三到四倍的運算量，在編碼和推理能力上媲美 GLM 5.2。其針對 Deepseek 和 Qwen 等中國開放權重競爭對手的策略是效率優先於原始效能。本文「Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China」最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 研究人員將 LeCun 的 JEPA AI 延伸為適用於從物理到生物學的通用世界模型 / Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology

sources.title: 研究人員將 LeCun 的 JEPA AI 延伸為適用於從物理到生物學的通用世界模型 / Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology
sources.title_zh: 研究人員將 LeCun 的 JEPA AI 延伸為適用於從物理到生物學的通用世界模型
sources.title_en: Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology
sources.title_original: Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology
sources.summary: Researchers at PhAI Labs have expanded Yann LeCun's JEPA architecture to work across seven fields, from robotics to biomedicine. The effort also produced a liver cancer treatment candidate that showed promise in lab tests, though the study doesn't establish whether it could become an actual therapy. The article Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: PhAI Labs 的研究人員將 Yann LeCun 的 JEPA 架構擴展至七個領域，從機器人技術到生物醫學。這項工作還產生了一個肝癌治療候選藥物，在實驗室測試中顯示出潛力，儘管該研究並未確立它是否能成為真正的療法。這篇文章「Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology」首先發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Meta 與 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手 / Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor

sources.title: Meta 與 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手 / Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.title_zh: Meta 與 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手
sources.title_en: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.title_original: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
sources.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
sources.summary: OpenAI is adding invisible textGrain watermarks to ChatGPT in the EU, but unlike Anthropic, it will let API customers worldwide opt out. Tests show detection rates as high as 95 percent, dropping to 17 percent when a quarter of the words are replaced. The article OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide appeared first on The Decoder .

stories.title: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制 / Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model

sources.title: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制 / Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.title_zh: Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制
sources.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.title_original: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
sources.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title_en: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.title_original: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Anthropic employees donated $540 million in 2025 alone, nearly five times as much as the next-largest Fortune 500 donors, thanks to a company program that tops up every stock donation with extra shares and triples contributions from early employees. The article Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 僅在 2025 年，Anthropic 的員工就捐贈了 5.4 該億美元，幾乎是財星 500 大企業中第二大捐贈者的五倍，這歸功於一項公司計畫：該計畫為每筆股票捐贈提供額外的股票配額，並將早期員工的捐款金額三倍化。相關文章 Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO 最初發布於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止 / Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds

sources.title: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止 / Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.title_zh: 新民調顯示：大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止
sources.title_en: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.title_original: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
sources.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

sources.title_en: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
sources.title_original: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
sources.summary: Aleph Alpha has released Kolibri, a German-English mixture-of-experts model with 78 billion parameters, about three billion of which are active per token. stories.title: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告

sources.title: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
sources.title_zh: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
sources.title_original: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
sources.summary: OpenAI宣佈將擴大ChatGPT廣告測試，10月稍晚將在美國的圖片生成功能中測試新的視覺廣告，以圖片呈現商品或服務，並與使用者生成的圖片分開顯示。OpenAI也擴充廣告成效追蹤及投放安全機制，讓廣告主瞭解廣告是否帶來購買等後續行動，同時避免廣告出現在敏感或不適合的對話旁。 新的視覺廣告會在使用者生成圖片時出現，可使用商品照片、使用情境或服務相關圖片呈現，並會明確標示為廣告，不會混入使用者要求ChatGPT生成的圖片。首波測試僅限美國及部分廣告主，OpenAI表示，廣告也不會影響ChatGPT產生的回答。

sources.summary: 10月2日GitLab發布AI Gateway重要修補更新19.2.4、19.3.2、19.4.1版，修補一個CVSS嚴重程度評為9.9分的漏洞CVE-2026-90970，影響18.1.6以上版本的AI Gateway，GitLab呼籲自行架設的用戶應立即套用其中一個新版因應；GitLab代管的AI Gateway已部署相關修正，用戶無須採取行動。

sources.summary: 紐約市議會10月5日舉行AI安全風險聽證會，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google與Meta代表透過視訊宣誓作證。市議會同時審議多項AI監管草案，其中一項要求在紐約市行銷、販售或部署的AI模型接受獨立第三方驗證，並具備可由人類操作人員關閉模型的技術能力。

sources.title_original: Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
sources.summary: Together AI has released Together Link, a free, MIT-licensed CLI that connects Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps to open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3. One install command sets it up, and an Auto router picks a model for each session. Together claims savings of over 50%. The post Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Together AI 全新奨出 Together Link，這是一款免費、採用 MIT 授權的 CLI，它可將 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 以及 Claude 與 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式連線到 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.3 等開放源模型。只需一個安裝命令即可完成設定，且自動路由器會為每個關暸選擇模型。Together 表示成本可灩省 50% 以上。本文首發於 MarkTechPost，標題為《Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode》。

stories.title: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點

sources.title: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點
sources.title_zh: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點
sources.title_original: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點
sources.summary: 挪威政府準備提出AI眼鏡臨時禁令，限制民眾在特定場所使用相關裝置，可能納入的地點包括公園、海灘、博物館、購物中心、學校與醫療院所等。禁令目前尚未生效，挪威政府將盡快向國會提出法案，實際適用場所及受管制裝置範圍仍待確認。 政府主要擔心，這類裝置可在旁人不知情的情況下拍照、錄影或錄音。規畫中的管制範圍包括民眾經常出入的公園、海灘、博物館與購物中心，也可能涵蓋遊樂園，以及體育、音樂與文化活動。

sources.summary: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

items.summary_zh: Reflection 正在將 Beam 和未來的模型推向企業與主權國家。其訴求是建立「人工智慧工廠」，這是一項能讓機構透過使用自身的專有資料來訓練 Reflection 的人工智慧模型，進而建構專屬且在地化的人工智慧系統的產品。

sources.title: Reka 發布 Rho-1：一款能同時理解、生成影片並輸出機器人動作的 19B 全能推理模型 / Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
sources.title_zh: Reka 發布 Rho-1：一款能同時理解、生成影片並輸出機器人動作的 19B 全能推理模型
sources.title_en: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
sources.title_original: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
sources.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: Instinct 將其 AI 代理引入群組聊天，甚至適用於沒有帳戶的朋友 / Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account

sources.title: Instinct 將其 AI 代理引入群組聊天，甚至適用於沒有帳戶的朋友 / Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
sources.title_zh: Instinct 將其 AI 代理引入群組聊天，甚至適用於沒有帳戶的朋友
sources.title_en: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
sources.title_original: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
sources.summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.
sources.summary_zh: Instinct 正在推出群組聊天功能，讓朋友們能夠一起使用其 AI 代理來執行諸如規劃旅行、組織共乘和協調活動等任務。該公司表示，個人帳戶將維持獨立，個人代理在分享資訊或採取行動之前必須先獲得許可。

stories.title: 超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域 / Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields

sources.title: 超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域 / Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
sources.title_zh: 超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域
sources.title_en: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
sources.title_original: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
sources.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_original: Wikipedia operator says OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ bots may be linked to a May outage
sources.summary: Following many recent disclosures about AI agents accessing third-party websites and services, the Wikimedia Foundation, which hosts Wikipedia, says that it "can confirm that we have discovered some activity" by "rogue" OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The activity includes edits to Wikimedia wikis, "unsuccessful attempts" to "exploit" the Etherpad note-taking tool that the Wikimedia Foundation […]
sources.summary_zh: 繼最近許多關於人工智慧代理存取第三方網站和服務的揭露之後，託管維基百科的維基媒體基金會表示，他們「可以證實我們已經發現」維基媒體平臺上出現了「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。這些活動包括對維基媒體 wiki 的編輯、「不成功的嘗試」來「利用」維基媒體基金會的 Etherpad 筆記工具 [...]

primary_item.summary_zh: 繼最近許多關於人工智慧代理存取第三方網站和服務的揭露之後，託管維基百科的維基媒體基金會表示，他們「可以證實我們已經發現」維基媒體平臺上出現了「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。這些活動包括對維基媒體 wiki 的編輯、「不成功的嘗試」來「利用」維基媒體基金會的 Etherpad 筆記工具 [...]

stories.news_summary: 維基媒體基金會證實，OpenAI 的「惡意」代理在維基媒體平臺上進行編輯，並嘗試利用 Etherpad 工具。該基金會表示，這些活動可能與五月的當機有關。

sources.title_original: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
sources.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, […]

sources.summary: Today, I’m talking with Sen. Adam Schiff, a Democrat from California. Schiff sits on a number of committees with oversight into tech and AI: intellectual property, antitrust, privacy and technology — it’s all there. I really wanted to ask him about how we might regulate anything related to the tech industry at this moment in […]
sources.summary_zh: 今天，我正在與來自加州的民主黨參議員亞當·希夫（Adam Schiff）對話。希夫參與了多個監督科技與 AI 的委員會：智慧財產權、反壟斷、隱私與技術——應有盡有。我真的很想問他，我們目前究竟該如何對科技產業的相關事務進行監管 […]
